title: List the Italian name of the card with the highest converted mana cost that
question: List the Italian name of the card with the highest converted mana cost that is legal in Commander format without a content warning and belongs to an expansion set that has a Japanese translation. The set must also appear in Brazilian Portuguese translations.

prediction.sql:
SELECT fd.XCL_079
FROM cards AS c
JOIN legalities AS l ON l.XCL_086 = c.XCL_072
JOIN sets AS s ON s.XCL_099 = c.XCL_063
JOIN foreign_data AS fd ON fd.XCL_082 = c.XCL_072
WHERE l.XCL_084 = 'commander'
  AND l.XCL_085 = 'Legal'
  AND c.XCL_064 IS NULL
  AND s.XCL_115 = 'expansion'
  AND fd.XCL_077 = 'Italian'
  AND c.XCL_063 IN (SELECT XCL_093 FROM set_translations WHERE XCL_092 = 'Japanese')
  AND c.XCL_063 IN (SELECT XCL_093 FROM set_translations WHERE XCL_092 = 'Portuguese (Brazil)')
ORDER BY c.XCL_011 DESC
LIMIT 1;
